thread:
Asha N: Ok team — roadmap alignment for Q4 private pilots. We need a single ordered list of ops tasks: contract sign, KMS + HSM, staging GPUs, runtime prewarm, customer smoke tests.
Tom B: Infra note — region pinning matters. Beacon wants eu-west-1. Provision time is ~8 business days for reserved nodes there. We can do temporary hosted routing in us-central to start.
Luis F: Runtime: suggest warmup script that primes KV caches and loads model shards. Also add a fast-kill guard if memory exceeds threshold.
Maya C: Product: customers want SLA 99.9 for pilot. Can security accept that for hosted-first? We need clarity on data residency and retention.
security-bot: Reminder: upload privacy impact assessment. KMS key policy review queued. Expect 6 business days after docs are complete.
Owen R: SRE: We'll need autoscaler bounds: min_instances=2, max_instances=12, scale_cooldown=60s. For canary set concurrency cap to 10rps.
Tom B: Also note GPU preemption windows — prefer non-preemptible for pilot to avoid noisy neighbor.
Luis F: Runtime config (minimal):
```
model_variant: q4_0_quant
cache_primer: /scripts/prime_kv.sh
prewarm_instances: 2
canary_percent: 5
```
Maya C: Launch sequencing proposal: 1) internal smoke (staging) 2) hosted beta (reduced concurrency) 3) dedicated prewarm + migration 4) full pilot. Each step needs signoff from infra,SRE,sec.
Asha N: Tradeoffs: hosted-first reduces infra lead time but increases operational burden (quotas, monitoring). Dedicated reduces variance but needs contracts and KMS. Which do we prefer if timeline is fixed to Dec 5?
Owen R: If fixed Dec 5, hosted-first + daily runbooks is realistic. Dedicated path risks missing date unless contracts finalize this week.
Nina K: Security: hosted-first acceptable if we enforce tokenization + no PII storage. If any PII path needed, we must block until HSM/KMS validated.
Maya C: Customers ok with hosted-first if we offer audit logs and a migration plan. I'll draft the customer-facing cadence.
Asha N: Action list: Tom — confirm region provision ETA; Nina — final KMS ETA; Luis — commit primer script and canary config; Owen — autoscaler and rollback hooks; Maya — customer comms and SLA note.
deploy-bot: Maintenance window reserved Dec 1 02:00-06:00 UTC for GPU provisioning in eu-west-1 (auto-created).
Asha N: Meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT to finalize. Drop updates here if anything slips.
